TRACE_PATTERNS = [
    "Traceback (most recent call last)",
    "File \"",
    "Exception:",
    "ValueError:",
    "TypeError:",
    "KeyError:",
]


def _contains_trace(text: str) -> bool:
    return any(pat in text for pat in TRACE_PATTERNS)
